Definition: What proportion of the electorate does the register cover?
Comments: ~8 million registered voters; high coverage of voting-age population.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: The cited ACE source is a 2012-13 BVR case study using an outdated ~8m voting-age-population estimate from a time when Cameroon's total population was ~20m. ELECAM's final count for the October 2025 presidential election shows 8,010,464 registered voters; with Cameroon's 2024 population at ~29.1m and roughly 55% aged 18+ (World Factbook/Worldometer age structure), the actual eligible electorate is closer to 16m, giving voter-register coverage of approximately 50%, not >89%. Revised down to 2 (20-49%); flagged for human review as the estimate sits close to the 50% boundary and no official government figure for the 18+ population was found.
